Stephen Curry's fourth NBA championship came in 2022 over Boston, his first Finals MVP.
Nikola Jokic won three NBA MVP awards between 2021 and 2024 (2021, 2022, 2024).
Kareem Abdul-Jabbar won six regular-season MVP awards (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980).
